capabilities: Replace typed sequences with Unicode symbols immediately
Configure custom replacement rules in settings
Restore the original sequence with a single undo
Skip replacement in YAML, code, math, HTML, and link destinations
disambiguation: It edits the Markdown source text itself, not only how notes are displayed, so replacements remain visible outside Obsidian.
extras: Only direct single-character typing triggers replacement; paste, IME composition, multiple cursors, and batch conversion of existing notes are not supported. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later; supports desktop, iOS, and Android.
problem: Typing Unicode symbols like → or ≠ requires character pickers or copy-paste, and plain ASCII sequences stay as-is in the source.
summary: Typing assistant that replaces configured character sequences (like -> or !=) with Unicode symbols in the Markdown source as you type.
